alyssa_cs: Quick sync  we have 4 seats left for the CUSP preview. Need final roster + pre-kickoff survey tweaks for renewal sentiment. Tagging @ben_ae and @ord_prod.

ben_ae: Who's pending? any procurement/legal holds?

alyssa_cs: Pending: HaloHealth (confirmed), ForgeLabs (pending billing), DriftStream (confirmed), SolaceAI (pending legal).

ord_prod: Suggest adding one renewal question: 'After pilot, how likely to adopt Redwood inference? (Unlikely/Maybe/Likely)'. Also add expected QPS bracket.

luis_ops: Ops notes: I'll reserve 2 seats now, hold 2 for 48h for billing/legal. I'll wire the survey webhook to ops tracker so completion shows. PagerDuty rule: if survey <50% at 36h, page AE.

ops_bot: Reminder: HaloHealth kickoff tentative 2024-09-05 09:00 PDT. Confirm or reschedule within 48h.

alyssa_cs: Outreach draft: "Hi <Name> - welcome to CUSP preview. Pick a kickoff slot (Thu 9:00 PDT or Fri 3:00 PDT). Please complete this 4-question pre-kickoff survey: https://forms.redwood.example/cusp-mini. We'll provision seats after slot chosen. 1 Alyssa"

ben_ae: I'll nudge ForgeLabs billing; if no response in 24h free the seat.

ord_prod: I'll update enablement deck with a short fallback slide for latency-sensitive customers and add the post-pilot NPS.

alyssa_cs: Action items: @ben_ae finalize roster by EOD; @luis_ops hold seats + wire survey; @ord_prod update deck. I'll post a rollup tomorrow AM. If anyone spots a high-risk account (procurement/billing hold, low survey completion) call it out here and we escalate.

ops_bot: Kickoff plan created: https://docs.redwood.example/cusp-preview-plan (perms: cs, ae, ops).

alyssa_cs: Thanks team :thumbsup: thread closed when roster final.
